1: And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.
2: Even on My menservants and maidservants, I will pour out My Spirit in those days.
3: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke.
4: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
5: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.
